clue.text: Vital editing badly requiring input of a tech-savvy youngster

indicators.note: an input is something put in, so one letter goes inside the rearranged string
something done badly is botched, so the two words are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: the letters of both words, to be rearranged
taken as written

explanation.surface: Some careless editing calls in a young computer whizz to sort it out.
explanation.walkthrough: VITAL EDITING has twelve letters; the extra A is put into the rearrangement to make DIGITAL NATIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: A digital native is someone who grew up with computers and the internet, hence a young person at ease with technology.

clue.text: Onset of caries is found in one new gold tooth

indicators.note: found in means sitting inside, so this pair goes within the surrounding letters

parts.note: taken as written
standard abbreviation for new

parts.note: first letter of caries
Roman numeral one
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Tooth decay starts on a new gold tooth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caries' is tooth decay, which makes the surface feel clinical, but only its first letter is used. 'is' is kept as written rather than acting as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An incisor is one of the sharp front cutting teeth.

clue.text: One trailblazing star entertained by a fan of Queen

indicators.note: a guest entertained by a host is held within the host's home, so one piece sits inside another

parts.note: to be into something is to be a fan of it
a nova is a star that suddenly brightens
R for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A trailblazing star is fêted by a fan of the rock band Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen looks like the rock band, but it is the Latin Regina; and 'a fan of' becomes one word, since being into something means liking it.
explanation.definitionFit: An innovator introduces new methods, blazing a trail that others follow.

clue.text: Horrify a quiet friend

parts.note: taken as written
p for piano, the musical direction to play quietly
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone shocks a mild-mannered companion.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal is to fill with horror or dismay, a direct synonym for horrify.

clue.text: Most important anaesthetic assigned to surgeries centrally

parts.note: an anaesthetic is something that numbs, a numb-er
someone assigned to a job is on it

parts.note: the fifth of nine letters in surgeries

explanation.surface: The key thing for any operating theatre is the anaesthetic supplied to it.
explanation.walkthrough: NUMBER here is read as NUMB-ER, a thing that numbs, before it becomes part of the phrase NUMBER ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Number one describes whatever ranks first, so it serves as an informal adjective for the top priority.

clue.text: Support majority of the force

indicators.note: a majority is most but not all, so the final letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a golf tee supports the ball
taken as written, then shortened

explanation.surface: Backing for most of the police force.
explanation.definitionFit: Teeth in the figurative sense is power to enforce, as when a law is said to have teeth.

clue.text: Orchid seen in deep blue lake in Virginia

indicators.note: the second in places the dye and the lake inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: VA is the postal abbreviation of Virginia
anil is the indigo plant and the deep blue dye made from it
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A rare orchid is spotted growing by a deep blue lake in Virginia.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanilla is a genus of climbing orchid whose pods yield the flavouring.

clue.text: Opposing arguments perhaps given by solicitors from Coleman Curtis, misguidedly

definitions.text: Opposing arguments perhaps given by solicitors

indicators.note: something done misguidedly goes astray, so the letters wander out of order

parts.note: the letters of both names, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A law firm named Coleman Curtis makes a poorly judged rebuttal in court.
explanation.walkthrough: Coleman Curtis reads like a firm of solicitors, but the two names are just letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A counterclaim is a claim brought by a defendant against the claimant, the sort of rival argument lawyers put forward.

clue.text: Organise related checks and get ready for action

indicators.note: to organise is to put into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of both words, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Sort out the associated inspections and prepare to get going.
explanation.definitionFit: To clear the decks is an idiom from naval warfare: remove clutter so the ship is prepared to fight.

clue.text: Huge container — a sort once seen in Italy?

definitions.text: a sort once seen in Italy?

parts.note: OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize
a can is a container

explanation.surface: A giant container is described as a type once found in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort' here means a kind of person: one of an ancient people, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oscans were an ancient people of southern Italy whose language died out under Roman rule.

clue.text: Long borders made primarily for a large plant

indicators.note: to border something is to surround it, so the first word wraps the next letters

parts.note: to pine is to long for

indicators.note: primarily means at first, so just the opening letter of the word is kept

parts.note: first letter of made
per means for, as in a price per item
L is the abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Tall flowerbed edges were first made for a big plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long' looks like an adjective for the borders, but it is a verb meaning to yearn, and 'borders' is the verb that wraps it round the next letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The pimpernel is a small flowering plant, best known as the scarlet pimpernel.

clue.text: Architect with very bad English country home

parts.note: John Nash designed Regent Street and Brighton Pavilion
V is the abbreviation for very
ill can mean bad, as in ill effects
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: A designer comes up with an awful English country house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country home' suggests a rural mansion; it means the home of country music.
explanation.definitionFit: Nashville, Tennessee, is famous as the capital of country music.

clue.text: Confectionery almost cut in two (maybe just left of centre!)

indicators.note: almost signals a near miss: the word is right except for one letter, which is swapped

parts.note: to halve is to cut in two

explanation.surface: A sweet that has been nearly sliced in half, the knife slipping a little off-centre.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is almost the word for cutting in two, with one letter at the end changed; the bracketed aside jokes that a cut just off-centre is only almost a halving.
explanation.definitionFit: Halva is a dense sweet from the Middle East, usually made from sesame paste and sugar.

clue.text: Signs of hesitation covering up traitor's mistake

indicators.note: to cover something up is to enclose it, so the outer pair of sounds wraps around a word

parts.note: er and um are the sounds people make when hesitating
a rat is a traitor; the 's links to the definition

explanation.surface: Someone's ums and ers give away a traitor's blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: An erratum is an error in printing or writing, often listed on a correction slip.

clue.text: Rushed domestic worker said to dislike taking breaks in the end

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the word for the worker is replaced by one that sounds the same

parts.note: a maid is a domestic worker

indicators.note: taking means taking in, so the word for dislike holds a letter inside

parts.note: to hate is to dislike strongly

indicators.note: in the end points to the final letter of the word before it

parts.note: last letter of breaks

explanation.surface: A busy servant claims to resent taking breaks at the end of the day.
explanation.walkthrough: S goes inside HATE to make HASTE.
explanation.definitionFit: To make haste is to hurry, so made haste is the past tense of rushing.

clue.text: Curmudgeonly type occasionally howled if presented with trickery

indicators.note: occasionally means now and then, so only every other letter of the run is kept

parts.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters
art can mean cunning or trickery, as in artful

explanation.surface: A grumpy sort yelled whenever he was faced with a con.
explanation.walkthrough: The selection runs across two words, so 'if' has to be included.
explanation.definitionFit: Old fart is British slang for a stuffy, grumbling older person set in their ways.

clue.text: One painting a picture of small home surrounded by woodland creatures

indicators.note: something surrounded by another thing lies inside it, so the first pair goes within the animals

parts.note: deer live in woodland
S is the abbreviation for small
crib is slang for one's home

explanation.surface: An artist paints a tiny cottage ringed by forest animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'painting a picture' sounds like an artist, but it means describing in words.
explanation.definitionFit: A describer gives an account of something, figuratively painting a picture of it in words.

clue.text: Presided over church broadcast

parts.note: CH is the abbreviation for church
a broadcast programme is aired

explanation.surface: A service led by a minister was put out on radio.
explanation.definitionFit: To chair a meeting is to preside over it as its head.

clue.text: Request received by a PC link-up from part of the States

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: something received by another is taken in, so the request goes inside the next pieces

parts.note: a LAN is a local area network linking computers
to ask is to request

explanation.surface: A message comes through a computer network from somewhere in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Alaskan means belonging to Alaska, the largest US state.

clue.text: Catch some veterans nervously retreating

indicators.note: retreating means going back, so the found letters are read from right to left
some means a portion, so the letters lie inside the following words

parts.note: the letters running across the two words

explanation.surface: Some old soldiers anxiously backing off are caught.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensnare is to trap, as in a snare, so it is a synonym of catch.

clue.text: A Democrat flanked by great scholars

indicators.note: something flanked by another has it on both sides, so these letters sit inside

parts.note: ace means excellent, great
taken as written
Dem is the short form of Democrat

explanation.surface: A politician of the Democratic Party is surrounded by eminent academics.
explanation.definitionFit: Academe is the academic world, so collectively it stands for the scholars in it.

clue.text: Adjust plug fitting

parts.note: to plug a product is to advertise it, and an ad is an advert
apt means fitting or suitable

explanation.surface: Alter the fitting on an electrical plug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plug fitting' reads as an electrical part; plug here means a promotional mention.
explanation.definitionFit: To adapt is to modify for a new use, a straight synonym of adjust.

clue.text: Musically, everyone initially thinks ukuleles tear it up

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so the first letter of each of the following words is taken

parts.note: first letters of these three words

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means read from bottom to top, so the short word is turned around

parts.note: taken as written, then turned round

explanation.surface: Everyone in the band suspects the ukuleles are about to go wild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tear it up' is an idiom for playing with abandon, but 'tear' is only a source of its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is the Italian musical direction for all the performers to play together.

clue.text: Movement of bear in the winter

indicators.note: movement means the letters shift position, so they are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of all three words, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A bear moving around during winter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winter' reads as a noun; it is the verb, to spend the winter.
explanation.definitionFit: To winter is to pass the cold season somewhere, which is what animals do when they sleep through it.

clue.text: An extra book paid for by you and me

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for book

parts.words: paid for by you and me
parts.note: a round that is on us is one we pay for

explanation.surface: An additional book that the two of us bought.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonus is something extra on top of what is expected, such as extra pay.

clue.text: Repackaged Sky item about retired fighter

indicators.note: repackaged means put up in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letters of both words, to be rearranged
on means about, as in a talk on art

explanation.walkthrough: Sky is a British satellite TV broadcaster, which makes the surface read as a documentary.
explanation.definitionFit: Mike Tyson is a former world heavyweight boxing champion, long since out of the ring.

clue.text: Smash several pots on a table?

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a run of successful shots in snooker

explanation.walkthrough: The pots sound like crockery being smashed; they are snooker balls sunk on the table, where a sequence of them is called by this word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for shattering and a snooker term for a scoring sequence of pots in one visit.

clue.text: Vacant rooms in Vienna possibly house celebrations

indicators.note: possibly suggests one of several arrangements, so the city's letters are rearranged
